    - heading "Amazon Neptune" [level=1]
    - paragraph: Serverless graph database service for connected data and improved AI accuracy
    - button "Get started with Neptune"

    - heading "What is Neptune" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Neptune instantly scales graph workloads, removing the need to manage capacity. By modeling data as a graph, Neptune captures context that improves accuracy and explainability of generative AI applications. To make AI application development easier, Neptune offers fully managed GraphRAG with Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases, and integrations with Strands AI Agents SDK and popular agentic memory tools. It also easily analyzes tens of billions of relationships across structured and unstructured data within seconds delivering strategic insights. Neptune is the only database that gives you the power of connected data with the enterprise capabilities and value of AWS.
